LanguageData.TT_ModsToGroup: Buttons from mods go into the group "{0}"
LanguageData.TT_ModsToGroupTip: The game's own buttons stay on the bar; every button added by a mod goes into one group button that opens a menu. You can still put any of them back on the bar or into your own groups.
LanguageData.TT_AutoMove: Move buttons that don't fit into "More"
LanguageData.TT_AutoMoveTip: When the bar is full, the last buttons go into the "More" menu instead of being squeezed until their labels are cut.
LanguageData.TT_IconsSmall: Buttons with an icon show only the icon
LanguageData.TT_IconsSmallTip: A button that has an icon takes only the icon's width; its name is in the tooltip. Leaves more room for the others.
LanguageData.TT_Hint: Right click a button on the bar to move it into a group or back. Right click a group to sort its buttons. Hotkeys work everywhere.
